deviations.what: The FairDM account-center route is declared after the django-mvp include, not ahead of it as the plan says.
deviations.why: With the route first, reverse('account-center') still returned /account-center/account/, because Django reverses a name to the last pattern that carries it. After the include it returns /account-center/ and /account-center/login/ still answers; tests/test_conf/test_urls.py is untouched and passes.

deviations.what: get_visible_contributions sets record on projects and datasets only; samples and measurements are resolved to ids, and I changed the helper in my own T003 tests to compare each credit's kind and object id.
deviations.why: This is the D6 watch item, applied. No card lists a sample or a measurement. The T003 assertions compare the same expected records, and the edit touched only tests I wrote in this story.

deviations.what: Added DatasetQuerySet.get_visible() in fairdm/core/dataset/models.py and a Contributor.get_public_projects() / get_public_datasets() pair, with four tests for the queryset method.
